summary: Regression + auto-recovery verification of the reported 'preview nhi dikh rha hai' bug. All three targeted areas pass. (1) External preview URL renders login page with 'THE MANAGER' + 'Society Manager' + 'Mobile number' + 'Send code' — NOT blank. (2) /signup renders 'Create account' with 'As a Resident'/'As an Admin' toggle and 'Search for your society by name'. (3) Auto-recovery works: I explicitly killed redis-server (pkill -9) and stopped postgres (pg_ctl stop -m immediate on /app/.pgdata), then `sudo supervisorctl restart backend` — after ~8s, both redis and postgres were back up automatically (server.py -> bootstrap_env.sh), and POST /api/v1/auth/otp/request returned 200 without any manual service start. (4) End-to-end OTP: cleared otp:* keys, generated OTP via `app.services.otp_service.request_otp('9999999999')`, POSTed to /api/v1/auth/otp/verify with body {mobile, otp} and received JWT access+refresh tokens for PLATFORM_OWNER.
critical_code_review_comments: Auto-recovery via server.py._ensure_infra() + bootstrap_env.sh is a good durable fix. Confirmed idempotent — surviving a kill of both redis and postgres and returning to healthy on `supervisorctl restart backend` alone.
OTP verify endpoint accepts field name `otp` (not `code`) — worth noting in API docs; if frontend already uses `otp` (Login.tsx), this is fine. Non-blocking.

success_rate.backend: 100% (OTP request 200, OTP verify 200 with JWT, auto-recovery verified)
success_rate.frontend: 100% (login + signup render at external preview URL; 'Send code' wired to backend; cooldown error rendered correctly)

test_credentials: Mobile 9999999999 (Platform Owner). OTP: clear redis otp:* then `python -c "import asyncio; from app.services.otp_service import request_otp; print(asyncio.run(request_otp('9999999999')))"`. Verify with POST /api/v1/auth/otp/verify body {"mobile":"9999999999","otp":"<code>"}.

rca of the issue: Original RCA (iteration_1): Redis+Postgres not running, all auth 500. Durable fix now in place — /app/backend/server.py._ensure_infra() detects :5432/:6379 down and executes /app/backend/bootstrap_env.sh which starts redis, initializes/starts postgres at /app/.pgdata, runs alembic migrations, and seeds Platform Owner. Verified by hard-killing both services and observing them come back purely via `supervisorctl restart backend`. /api/v1/auth/otp/request => 200 post-restart with no human intervention.
